image_description: A vintage-style kitchen stove with four burners. On the stove, there are three pans: a black frying pan on the left containing dark food (possibly onions or mushrooms), a saucepan in the front with liquid and a spoon, and a cast iron skillet on the right with some residue. There are also two bowls containing what appear to be nuts or small food items. The stove has white enamel with chrome accents and control knobs on the front.
